top_stories.title: Billionaire wars: Jeff Bezos steals $230M Moon deal from Elon Musk as NASA selects Blue Origin for the first of three uncrewed lunar missions | - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **NASA** announced the selection of **Blue Origin**, a company founded by Jeff Bezos, to carry out the first in a planned series of three uncrewed lunar missions. The $230 million contract will see **Blue Origin's** Blue Moon cargo lander transport scientific payloads and test technologies near the Moon's south pole. This decision marks a symbolic win for **Bezos** in his ongoing rivalry with **Elon Musk**, whose company, SpaceX, remains deeply involved in NASA's Artemis program. The missions are part of NASA's effort to create an operational lunar base by the next decade and will help test technologies needed for future astronaut operations on the Moon.

top_stories.title: Chemical tank rupture in Washington state causes one death, multiple injuries - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: A chemical tank at a **Nippon Dynawave Packaging** facility in Longview, Washington ruptured on Tuesday morning, resulting in one fatality and nine injuries. The incident involved a tank containing approximately 900,000 gallons of white liquor, with officials stating that the tank remains unstable and recovery efforts will resume Wednesday.  The injured include eight employees and one firefighter who was treated and released from the hospital. **Governor Bob Ferguson** offered condolences to those affected by this tragedy.

top_stories.title: Gina Rinehart bankrolls purchase of 10% stake in Seven network owner Southern Cross Media | Gina Rinehart | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Gina Rinehart**, Australia’s richest person, has provided a loan to **Bruce McWilliam** for his acquisition of a nearly 10% stake in **Southern Cross Media**, which owns the Seven Network and other media brands. The investment, worth approximately $26 million, gives **Rinehart** significant influence over the company's future despite not directly owning shares.  This move marks **Rinehart’s** return to the media industry after a previous foray into the sector with Ten Network and Fairfax Media.

top_stories.title: HDFC Bank shares fall 2% on reports of internal probe over Rs 45 cr interest payments - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **HDFC Bank** allegedly routed differential interest payments to the **Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation (MSRDC)**, a state government agency, through its marketing department disguised as road safety awareness campaign sponsorship. This practice violated RBI regulations and the bank's own anti-bribery policy. The bank’s former chairman, Atanu Chakraborty, resigned on March 18th citing ethical concerns related to these practices.  The bank's share prices have declined significantly since the resignation.

top_stories.title: How badly is Europe affected by fertiliser shortages due to the Iran war? | Food News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **European Union** is launching a new Fertiliser Action Plan to address disruptions caused by the war in Iran and the Strait of Hormuz. The plan includes emergency financial support for farmers, increased imports from other countries, and measures to boost domestic production. While Europe's reliance on Gulf supplies is less than some regions, rising fertiliser prices due to the disruption are impacting food production costs and competitiveness.  The EU acknowledges that these challenges could lead to a backlash against green policies in rural areas as right-wing and populist parties gain ground.

top_stories.title: AI-Guided Cruise Missiles: 'Special mission warhead': North Korea tests AI-guided cruise missiles, ballistic rockets near South Korea | - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **North Korea** conducted a series of missile tests, including tactical ballistic missiles, artillery rockets, and AI-guided cruise missiles, near **South Korea**. The tests were designed to assess the power of a "special mission warhead" mounted on the missiles and the accuracy of the AI-guided cruise missiles.  **Kim Jong Un**, leader of **North Korea**, stated that these weapons will be deployed near the border with **South Korea**, equipped with precision navigation and AI-guided control capable of striking targets at 100 km (62 miles).

top_stories.title: Centre fears ‘divergence of views’ among High Courts on new transgender law; asks SC to transfer cases to itself - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Centre** urged the **Supreme Court** to transfer petitions challenging the constitutionality of the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Act, 2026 from four High Courts to itself. Solicitor General Tishar Mehta argued that High Courts may pre-empt the apex court by taking up the cases before them and passing orders. The petitions, led by activists like Laxminarayan Tripathi, criticize the Act for removing the right to self-identity and requiring a medical board's recommendation for gender recognition.

top_stories.title: Israel claims it killed new Hamas armed wing chief in Gaza strike - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Israel** announced the killing of **Mohammed Odeh**, the new head of Hamas's armed wing in Gaza, in a strike on Tuesday.  **Israel Defense Minister Israel Katz** and **Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu** stated that Odeh was responsible for the October 7th massacre and had been appointed to succeed Ezzedine al-Haddad, who was killed by an Israeli strike earlier this month. The **IDF** and **Shin Bet** were praised for their execution of the operation.

top_stories.title: Amanda Rishworth says jobseekers will no longer be forced to submit ‘endless’ pointless job applications | Australian politics | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Amanda Rishworth**, the **employment minister**, announced a new three-stream system for the employment services sector, aiming to address concerns about its current "one-size fits all" approach. The system will differentiate between jobseekers based on their skills and work readiness, offering digital resources for those ready to work, targeted support for skill building, and intensive services for complex cases. While welcoming changes to mutual obligations activities, advocacy groups like **Acoss** and the **Community and Public Sector Union** called for a complete overhaul of the privatized model, arguing it has failed jobseekers and the government.

top_stories.title: Adani Power surpasses Infosys in market capitalisation after 126% rally in one year - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Adani Power**'s stock surged to become India's 11th most valued company, driven by soaring power demand fueled by the intense El Niño year and heatwave conditions.  The surge comes as **India** grapples with record-breaking temperatures, placing it among the world's hottest cities. **Infosys**, meanwhile, saw its share price decline due to concerns about the impact of AI advancements on the software-as-a-service market.
